name: Services MUST have an out-of-hours on-call contact for critical service incident escalation to ensure immediate action can be taken during high-risk periods.
requirementTitle: Services MUST have an out-of-hours on-call contact for critical service incident escalation to ensure immediate action can be taken during high-risk periods.
requirementDescription: Every service must have someone available to be contacted outside normal working hours in case a serious incident occurs and urgent action is needed.
why:
- Critical incidents can happen at any time.
- Fast response often reduces damage and recovery time.
- Security teams need someone who understands the service.
- Business-critical services may require 24/7 support arrangements.

actions.title: Services MUST have an out-of-hours on-call contact for critical service incident escalation to ensure immediate action can be taken during h
actions.description: Every service must have a person or team that can be contacted outside normal working hours so that serious incidents can be responded to immediately rather than waiting until the next working day.
